origins.title: Miner's child
origins.line: You grew up under the Copper Hills. You hear rock crack before it falls.

origins.title: Woodcutter's {son|daughter|child}
origins.line: You can tell oak from ash by the sound of the axe.

origins.title: Smith's apprentice
origins.line: Your hands carry burns from a forge that was never quite yours.

origins.title: Fisher from the coast
origins.line: You learned to read the water before you could read words.

origins.title: Hunter's apprentice
origins.line: You walk soft, and you have never stepped on a dry branch.

origins.title: Tavern cook
origins.line: You have fed a full tavern at midnight. A camp fire holds no fear for you.
